3. THE TWO LICENSES

Your license is one of the following, as stated on your invoice or license
certificate. If none is stated, you have a Single-Machine License.

  SINGLE-MACHINE LICENSE. You may install and use RetrOS/LT on one
  computer at a time. You may move it to another computer, if you remove
  it from the first.

  BLANKET LICENSE. You may install and use RetrOS/LT on any number of
  computers that you own or lease, at any of your locations, and may make
  as many copies as you need for that. Your employees and members may use
  it on those computers. A Blanket License does not cover computers that
  you do not own or lease, such as those of your employees at home.

Under either license you may make copies of the diskettes for backup and
archival purposes, and may print or copy the Guide to Operations for use
with your licensed computers.
